title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Ballkone tek Pallatet Cabej
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Ballkone tek Pallatet Cabej.
Apartamenti disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 95 m2 nga te cilat 87.1 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendshme.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet, 2 ballkone, nje korridor i cili ben te mundur shperndarjen e ambienteve te apartamentit si dhe 2 depo.
Orientimi Jug-Perendim ben te mundur qe apartamenti te kete drite natyrale pergjate pjeses me te madhe te dites.
title_en: 2+1+2 Balcony Apartment for sale at Cabej Buildings
description_en: 2+1+2 Balcony Apartment for sale at Cabej Buildings. The apartment has a total surface of 95 m2, of which 87.1 m2 are part of the interior surface. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen and dining area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 2 balconies, a corridor which makes it possible to distribute the premises of the apartment as well as 2 storage rooms. The South-West orientation makes it possible for the apartment to have natural light throughout most of the day.
